title: Fix CI build, lint, and test failures
body:
CI on main is broken across all four jobs (Build Core, Build Docs, Lint, Test) due to three independent issues.

### `plugin-dashboard` build failure — react-grid-layout v2.2.2 API migration

`WidthProvider` HOC was removed in react-grid-layout v2.x. Migrated to the new hook-based API:

```tsx
// Before
import { Responsive, WidthProvider } from 'react-grid-layout';
const ResponsiveGridLayout = WidthProvider(Responsive);

// After
import { ResponsiveGridLayout, useContainerWidth } from 'react-grid-layout';
const { width, containerRef, mounted } = useContainerWidth();
```

- `isDraggable` / `isResizable` → `dragConfig.enabled` / `resizeConfig.enabled`
- `draggableHandle` → `dragConfig.handle`
- Container ref + `width` prop replaces the HOC's auto-measurement
- Grid only renders after `mounted` to avoid zero-width flash

### `permissions` lint errors

- `store.ts`: Split destructuring into `const` (non-reassigned `roles`, `user`) and `let` (reassigned `permissions`, `userRoles`)
- `useFieldPermissions.ts`: Removed unused `FieldLevelPermission` import
- `usePermissions.ts`: Removed unused `useCallback` import

### `plugin-designer` lint error (previously masked by permissions failure)

- `CollaborationProvider.tsx`: Replaced synchronous `setState` inside `useEffect` with `useMemo`-derived state, fixing `react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` error
- `PageDesigner.tsx`: Prefixed unused `setZoom` setter with underscore
- `ProcessDesigner.tsx`: Removed unused `Plus` import

### Pre-existing unrelated failures

7 test failures in `plugin-chatbot` and `plugin-report` are pre-existing from the react-syntax-highlighter upgrade and not addressed here.
